ignoreValues.reason: false positive: .facet-tag::before is a 0x0 border-triangle chevron glyph before a kicker label (border-left solid + top/bottom transparent, classic CSS triangle hack), not a card side-accent stripe

legitimate one-offs: #fff is required by .wordmark's mix-blend-mode:difference (needs true white to invert correctly against arbitrary video content, --ink's off-white would not); rgba(4,4,3,x) family are the hero scrim gradient stops (directional darkening over the video, same near-black base at several alphas, not a page background)

the real type ramp is intentionally more granular than DESIGN.md's 4 representative frontmatter tokens (hero-display/display/body/label); the full set of steps (0.78-2rem across labels, body, component titles, quotes, CTA) is documented in prose under DESIGN.md's Typography > Hierarchy section
